name: Post Matric Scholarship Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / Tribal Affairs

eligibility.other_conditions: Enrolled in recognized post-matriculation or post-secondary courses (Class 11 to PhD).

benefits: Complete reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable course fees and monthly maintenance allowance up to Rs 13,500 per year.
documents_required: Fee Receipt and College Bonafide Certificate
application_process: Register online on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP).
Fill student profile, academic records, and upload verification docs.
Institute verifies application, followed by State Nodal Officer approval.
